title: Finite machine associated to a coded machine
statement: For a coded nondeterministic machine with two work tapes, associate the finite machine with the same transition behavior, two work tapes, and state set consisting of the indices $0,\ldots,n$, where $n$ is the coded machine’s state parameter.
